confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, booking pages or listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, and drinks are less certain because alcohol pricing in Chennai varies by licensed venue and tax. The FX value comes from the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page as summarised in search results; I did not open the page directly and did not confirm a 16 October observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general pricing for large South Indian metros such as Bengaluru and Hyderabad, adjusted for Chennai's tourist accommodation and restaurant levels. July 2026 is treated as a standard month, not peak or off-season.
